none.doc: the served model, untouched — the do-nothing degenerate

linear_decay.doc: OLS ramp a + b·week over weeks 1–3

shrunk_bucket.doc: positive-part James–Stein shrink of the bucket constant toward 0 by its own SE

pooled_level.doc: MATCHED FOIL (SCOPING) — the POOLED mean error applied to EVERY row. Winning would mean the effect is a season-wide level, not a cold start (VAL2's ⛔ would be wrong).

week_blind.doc: MATCHED FOIL (MAGNITUDE) — the POOLED magnitude applied to weeks 1–3 ONLY. Holds the SCOPING fixed and removes the week-informed MAGNITUDE (NF-D15 g′).

over_scale.doc: 2 × the bucket constant. Winning would mean the estimator UNDER-corrects (NF-D20).

oracle_bucket.doc: PEEKING bucket floor: the bucket constant computed on the EVAL fold's own weeks 1–3. Reported as the headline peek; C8 uses each arm's OWN-form peek (NF-D16 g‴).

matched_n_bucket.doc: `bucket_shift`'s estimator on a random in-fold slice sized to the eval fold's own wk1-3 n — what makes the peek readable at matched family AND matched sample (NF1.9 (f)).

over_tilt.note: DESCRIPTIVE. The model's side vs the close on the cold-start rows, before and after each arm's shift. Never a clause; best_alpha = 0 and no edge claim is made.
